risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (394.7), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational revenues; earnings in 83 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with three white soldiers + supertrend bullish + hull bullish creates technical structure, and fear zone (35 sentiment score) offers contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI 9/14/21 and Stochastic 80.5 with no fresh crossover signals, extreme 15x volume spike suggesting climactic move, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY), and zero fundamental/smart money conviction make this a high-risk exhaustion setup.
